synopsis:
Hades is planning to take over the world, to achieve that goal, he sends out deceased Gold Saints to take Athena's head. Seiya and the other Bronze Saints come to help but their help isn't appreciated by the remaining Gold Saints that are still alive. 

(Source: ANN)
synopsis_es:
Hades planea apoderarse del mundo y, para lograr ese objetivo, envía a los Gold Saints fallecidos para tomar la cabeza de Atenea. Seiya y los otros Santos de Bronce vienen a ayudar, pero los Santos de Oro restantes que aún están vivos no aprecian su ayuda. 

(Fuente: ANN)

episodes_data.title: The Start of a New Holy War
episodes_data.title_es: El comienzo de una nueva guerra santa
episodes_data.description: The old master has a vision in which Athena is decapitated by Hades.

episodes_data.title: The Three of the Lament
episodes_data.description: Aphrodite and Death Mask see that Seiya`s body is gone, but the third Saint doubts Mū killed Pegasus.

episodes_data.title: The Shadow of the One Who Struggles
episodes_data.description: The Spectre Radamanthys of Wyvern meets his love, Pandora.

episodes_data.title: Expiation of the Immortal
episodes_data.description: Saga tells Shura and Camus to continue, as he`ll take care of Gemini. Saga recognizes the opponent as his brother.

episodes_data.title: Transient Meeting
episodes_data.description: Saga, Shura, and Camus find that the interior of the house of Cancer has become a gateway to the world of the dead.

episodes_data.title: The Ancient Warrior
episodes_data.description: Dohko and Shion begin to fight, but the Knight of Libra is overpowered.

episodes_data.title: The Herd of Black Cloaks
episodes_data.description: Mū reachs the remains of the house of Cancer, but is immobilized by a large group led by Spectrum Giganto of Cyclops and Papillon Myu.

episodes_data.title: The Moment of Vacillation
episodes_data.description: The Spectras arrive at the house of Leo, meeting Aioria.

episodes_data.title: At the End of Pride
episodes_data.description: Giganto is furious when he learns that Saga and the others killed three Specters to impersonate them against Shaka.

episodes_data.title: The Golden Clash
episodes_data.description: Shaka of Virgo is dead. But in the Garden, three Knights are surprised to see Shaka still there.

episodes_data.title: Shaking Sanctuary
episodes_data.description: Shion and Dohko are still alive, and the previous Patriarch cries over the deaths of Aldebaran, Death Mask, and Aphrodite.

episodes_data.title: The Cloth of Athena
episodes_data.description: Shion wakes the armor of Athena, which is the true form of the giant statue of the goddess.

episodes_data.title: The Morning of the Resolution
episodes_data.description: The Bronze Saints want to fight Radamanthys, but the Golden Knights stop them.
